description:
Team Name: Lunar Legacy Team

Team Leader: Amrutha j r

We are a team of students interested in space exploration, science, technology, and creative problem-solving. Our team aims to make NASA's space exploration history more accessible through research, digital storytelling, and innovative presentation methods.

Through our project, The Lunar Legacy, we explore the stories behind objects left on the Moon and Mars.
summary: The Lunar Legacy is an educational digital museum designed to preserve and share the stories of human-made objects left on the Moon and Mars. The project explores the historical and scientific importance of space mission equipment, including Apollo lunar hardware and components from NASA's Perseverance landing system. Through an interactive digital exhibition, visitors can discover the purpose of each object, understand why it remained on another planet or the Moon, and learn about its contribution to space exploration. The platform will include object descriptions, mission information, photographs, educational comparisons, and links to authentic NASA research. The main objective is to transform technical space mission records into engaging digital stories while encouraging responsible exploration and preservation of humanity's space heritage.
details: The Lunar Legacy is an educational digital museum project designed to explore and preserve the stories of human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. The project focuses on transforming discarded spacecraft components, scientific instruments, landing equipment, tools and other mission-related objects into meaningful digital exhibits. Through an interactive digital platform, users will be able to explore these objects, understand their original purposes, learn about the missions they belonged to, and discover their historical and scientific importance. The project will feature separate galleries for the Moon and Mars, containing photographs, object descriptions, mission information and educational content based on authentic NASA research. It will also include interactive storytelling, digital illustrations and comparisons between different space missions. The proposed platform will be developed using digital design and web technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The main objective is to make space exploration history more accessible and interesting while encouraging scientific curiosity, technological awareness and responsible preservation of humanity's achievements beyond Earth. Through this project, our team aims to demonstrate how digital technology and creative storytelling can turn forgotten mission objects into valuable educational experiences for future generations.
